newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern files $3 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern files $3 bln shelf.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp filed Thursday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $3 billion in debt securities, preferred and common stock.
When combined with previous registrations, Norfolk will have a total $4.3 billion in securities and stock available for sale.

Net proceeds will be used to fund the purchase of shares in relation to its pending tender offer or any other related tender offer in which it may participate, and to acquire assets or concessions relating to the assets or operations of Conrail, the filing said.
Norfolk intends to use the balance, if any, to purchase shares of common from time to time in open market transactions in relation to an ongoing share purchase program started by Norfolk in 1987.
Balance will also be applied to retiring all or a portion of the company's short-term debt, to acquire new or used property and to meet general corporate purposes.
